# #001 performance notes

## 29 Sep 2026: first 2 days (published 27 Sep, auto-generated thumbnail, no pinned comment)

| Metric | Value |
|---|---|
| Views | 26 (13 on each day) |
| Watch time | 2.59 h |
| Average view duration | ~6:00 (48% of 12:28), derived from watch time ÷ views |
| Impressions | 531 |
| Impressions CTR | 1.69% (≈ 9 views came from impressions) |
| Subscribers | 0 |

What it suggests, with only 26 views behind it:

- **Retention is the good news.** Viewers who start watch about half the video. For a 12-minute documentary, anything above 35–40% is healthy. So the script and visuals are holding people, and that is the metric that is hardest to fix later.
- **Click-through rate is the problem, as expected.** 1.69% is low, but it was measured on an auto-selected frame, which on this video is a dark underwater or storm shot. The custom thumbnails are the fix.
- **About 17 of the 26 views didn't come from impressions.** Those are direct, external or channel-page views. If any were our own test plays, the retention figure is inflated. Check the traffic sources.

Actions taken or recommended:

1. Upload `thumb-a.jpg` and start Test & Compare with A, B and C.
2. Post and pin the pinned comment from `package.md`.
3. For the 7-day review, export Traffic source (with impressions and CTR per source) and screenshot the audience retention curve. This export only had the summary table.
